# Final Review Votes
**Producer:** agent:claude/claude-opus-4-6

## Summary

Accept fixture deduplication and missing shrimp-death trace assertion as real, verified issues. Reject the scenario-tuning amendment because the cited values are already committed and git status shows no uncommitted changes to those files.

## Votes

- `fr-3-e46f2f7d`: Accept
  Verified: all 6 fixtures and 3 helpers are copy-pasted between conservation_regression.rs and e2e_conservation.rs. Minor divergence already exists — dump_trace uses different temp directory names and one copy includes an eprintln the other lacks. This is a real drift hazard for scientifically tuned test fixtures and extracting them into a shared module is a sound maintainability improvement.
- `fr-3-f6f2eb7f`: Accept
  Verified: the doc comment on closed_system_mortality_senescence_conserves_n_and_c explicitly claims 'shrimp death and plant senescence route biomass to detritus' is tested, yet the four assert_trace_delta calls only cover system:daily_plants and system:daily_algae. There is no assertion for system:daily_shrimp → detritus.fine_g. The aggregate conservation check (assert_conserved) would still pass even if shrimp death routing regressed, so this is a genuine coverage gap between documented intent and actual verification.
- `fr-3-73c7af43`: Reject
  Verified stale: moderate_planted.toml already has alkalinity_meq_per_l = 0.58 and bicarbonate_mg_per_l = 35.4 committed at HEAD. Git status and git diff confirm no uncommitted modifications to either moderate_planted.toml or medium_planted.toml. The amendment describes a problem that has already been resolved, so there is no outstanding defect to address.
